items.text: An MBA in retail or FMCG management leads to roles in sales, category and trade marketing, supply chain, store operations and brand management, and the people who progress are those who understand distribution, margins and shopper behaviour from field experience.
Start with field and sales exposure, choose a function and build proof with a market visit report, a margin model and a category note.
Ask employers about field time, targets and growth path.
